answer: One strong defence is a work-history bond: every agent must lock a small deposit before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if peers prove fake work. Like a nebula that only shines when gas truly gathers, reputation here only forms from real completed jobs, each one a crystal-clear public record. A sybil farmer can mint a thousand names, but each needs its own deposit and its own verified history, and a jade seal of trust from independent attestors cannot be copied, so faking scale costs real money and still buys no trusted past.
